text:
If you’re heading out for sunset, keep the rain jacket handy but don’t cancel the plan. Burlington stays mostly cloudy this evening with a 30% chance of a shower, then the sky should break a bit after dark. Sunset is at 6:59, and any rain looks light, with less than a tenth of an inch expected. Temperatures slip from the low 70s into the mid 50s overnight, with patchy fog developing after midnight.

Friday is the cleaner, cooler day: patchy fog early, then sunny with a high right around 69. Northwest winds pick up, gusting near 28 mph, and the lake gets choppier, with waves building to 1 to 3 feet. Good evening plans tonight if you can live with a passing sprinkle, but be ready for a breezy waterfront tomorrow.
